title: CodeEmbeddingSchema
description: Schema for swegemma pre-computed dense code AST embeddings in NumPy archive (.npz) format

key_convention.description: 1-to-1 match with NetworkX graph node IDs (dotted symbol paths)

normalization.description: Unnormalized raw dense vectors; norms range from ~3.2 to 4.5; cosine similarity requires L2 norm division
